contract:
Same file, strictly after F5c-1 merges. Officer surfaces + the never-shipped invites-spec settings work.

- CreateOrgModal (:860-1040): replace 'Visibility' (:1005-1037) with Field 'Who can join' (WHO_CAN_JOIN_OPTIONS, default open) and Field 'Open to' (openToOptions(viewer campus as {name, shared} when known, else null), default both) with AUDIENCE_HELP and OFFICER_FOLLOW_HELP hints. POST body (:895-901) sends join_policy + audience, no is_public; a non-ok response shows data.error (audience_excludes_owner copy comes from orgs/route.ts:85-92).
- OrgSettingsModal: SettingsTab (:1252) = 'overview'|'channels'|'members'|'followers'|'invites'|'requests'|'danger'. Tabs (:1281-1287) in order: Overview (always) · Channels (canManage) · Members (always) · Followers (canManage) · Invites (canManage) · Requests (isStaff — shown for every policy, because an OPEN club still receives requests from visiting students, join-state.ts:413-428) · Danger (always).
- SettingsOverview canManage (:1480-1505): replace Field 'Visibility' with 'Who can join' + 'Open to' (openToOptions from org.campus_id via campusRowById/isSharedCampus) + AUDIENCE_HELP + OFFICER_FOLLOW_HELP. When switching to Invite only while the Requests list is non-empty, show '{n} pending requests stay in Requests until you approve or deny them.' (n from a GET /requests read; omit the line if that read fails). dirty (:1410-1416) compares join_policy/audience; PATCH body (:1422-1435) drops is_public and sends join_policy / audience only when changed. When org.hidden, both fields render read-only (the PATCH would 409 org_hidden).
- Read-only view (:1452-1461): replace 'Visibility' with ReadOnlyRow 'Who can join' = whoCanJoinFact, 'Open to' = openToFact, 'Followers' = String(n) only when followerCountText(org.follower_count) is non-null; add a muted line 'Only owners and admins can change this.' when role is mod.
- NEW SettingsFollowers({org}): GET `/api/orgs/{handle}/followers?limit=50` (+cursor) via vibeRequest quiet, failure "Couldn't load followers."; first-load failure -> LoadFailed + Retry, later page failure -> toast. Header: count number -> '1 follower' / '{n} followers' (exact; officers only; no floor); count null -> 'Followers'. Button 'Invite followers' -> setTab('invites'). Rows in server order (first_followed_at desc, id desc — never re-sorted client-side, C5/C15): avatar, name (or @handle), '@handle', sub followsSinceText(first_followed_at), chip 'Member' when is_member. Non-member rows: 'Remove' (outline) -> window.confirm('Remove {name} from {org}'s followers? They'll stop getting its posts. They can follow again.') -> DELETE `/api/orgs/{handle}/followers/{userId}` -> remove row, toast 'Follower removed'; 409 member_follows -> mark is_member, toast 'Members follow automatically.' 'Show more' when next_cursor. Empty: 'Nobody follows {org} yet. Share the club's page — people who follow it show up here.' (Per-row 'Invite to join' from spec §5.5 is deliberately routed through the Invites tab, which opens on these same followers with the full invite states, so there is one invite-state renderer.)
- NEW Invites tab: <OrgInviteSheet handle={org.handle} orgName={org.name} audience={org.audience ?? 'both'} presentation='inline' />.
- SettingsRequests (:2026-2170): RequestRow gains eligible: boolean, ineligible_reason: 'audience_iu'|'audience_purdue'|'unverified'|null. When eligible === false hide Approve and show 'Not eligible (Purdue student)' for audience_iu, 'Not eligible (IU student)' for audience_purdue, 'Not eligible (no verified school email)' for unverified. Approve 409s (audience_mismatch, org_hidden) show the server error in the existing err line.
- SettingsDanger leave confirm (:2191) -> `Leave ${org.name}? You'll lose access to its chats. Its posts stop too, unless you followed it before joining.` (Franky answer 2 / trigger org_members_unfollow_on_leave: only the join-sourced follow is removed).
acceptance: npx tsc --noEmit clean; eslint count not above HEAD.
`grep -n "is_public" src/app/campus/campus-home.tsx` -> only the SearchOrg, FeedOrg and MapOrg type declarations (:3549, :4307, :9394).

As the SAE owner at 1280px (read-only walk, no saves): tabs read Overview · Channels · Members · Followers · Invites · Requests · Danger; Overview shows 'Invite only' + 'All of Indianapolis (IU + Purdue)' with both help lines; Followers tab lists the backfilled follower(s) with 'Member' chip and no Remove button; Invites tab opens on followers-who-aren't-members (empty copy for SAE today).

Overrides: Followers tab with 60 rows paginates via next_cursor without duplicates; Remove on a non-member row sends DELETE /followers/{id}; a requests override with eligible:false shows 'Not eligible (Purdue student)' and no Approve.
Saving only the club name sends a PATCH body with no join_policy, audience or is_public key (network log, on a local/dev org, never SAE in prod).
